column1: # Stage B of the refactor program (#2062): where each item of
# src/app/language_servers.rs goes. One row per item, in file order. pr 0 means the item
# stays in language_servers.rs; the others move to src/app/language_servers/<file>.rs in
# that PR. kind, impl and name are as `scripts/check_pure_move.py list` prints them. Run
# `scripts/move_items.py --target language_servers --check` after adding an item to
# language_servers.rs. language_servers.rs keeps the types and constants its parts share.
